items.title: The First Bancorp Announces Second Quarter Results
items.summary: Net Interest Margin Expansion and Improved Efficiency Lead to an 18.6% Increase in Second Quarter Earnings The First Bancorp (Nasdaq: FNLC), ("the Company", "we", "us", "our"), parent company of First National Bank, today reported unaudited results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026. Net income for the second quarter was $9.6 million with fully diluted earnings per share of $0.85, increases of 18.6% and 17.8%, respectively, from net income of $8.1 million and diluted earnings per share of $0.72 for the quarter ended June 30, 2025. Strong earnings for the period were driven by sustained net interest margin expansion, enhanced non-interest income, and disciplined expense control. Year-to-date in 2026, net income was $18.6 million with fully diluted earnings per share of $1.65, increases of 22.5% and 21.7%, respectively, from net income of $15.1 million and earnings per share of $1.35 for the six months ended June 30, 2025.
